battle.name: 墨西哥獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 墨西哥獨立戰爭於1810年爆發，多洛雷斯伊達爾戈的起義標誌反抗西班牙殖民統治。西班牙軍隊裝備序列中的火繩槍（Matchlock musket）於1520年列裝，屬早期制式火槍，主要供步兵進行遠距射擊；至獨立戰爭爆發時，它已是舊式裝備，未必仍是一線部隊的標準配備。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 1810 年的戰場橫跨新西班牙總督區。起義由多利亞斯出發，經聖米格爾、瓜納華托、聖路易斯波托西與瓦利亞德利德，推進至瓜達拉哈拉及莫爾雷亞；希達戈在蒙特德拉克魯塞斯受挫後，殘部轉向聖布拉斯與巴漢。帝國軍以墨西哥城、普埃布拉、凡塞拉等港口和各省會為支點，控制主要公路，並以獨立縱隊追擊。1811 年以後，行動中心南移至米却肯、瓦哈卡與薩莫拉，格雷羅在南部維持游擊戰；1821 年，伊圖維德與聯軍由哈利斯科向瓜納華托施壓。交戰的兩大政治實體是西班牙殖民當局與後來建國的墨西哥；美國及其他外國政府先後承認墨西哥獨立，但沒有外國正規遠征軍加入作戰。
countriesEn: The theater of war in 1810 stretched across the Captaincy General of New Spain. The uprising began at Dolores and passed through San Miguel, Guanajuato, San Luis Potosí, and Valladolid before advancing toward Guadalajara and Morelia. After Hidalgo was checked at Monte de las Cruces, the remnants of his force turned toward San Blas and Baján. The imperial army relied on Mexico City, Puebla, the port of Veracruz, and provincial capitals as bases from which it controlled the principal roads and dispatched independent columns in pursuit. After 1811, military operations shifted southward into Michoacán, Oaxaca, and Zamora, while Guerrero maintained an insurgency in the south. In 1821, Iturbide and the allied army pressed toward Guanajuato from Jalisco. The principal opposing political entities were the Spanish colonial authorities and the forces that would establish independent Mexico. The United States and other foreign governments subsequently recognized Mexican independence, but no foreign regular expeditionary army entered the war.
people: 米格爾·伊達爾戈原為堂區司鐸，具備民兵經驗；他於 1810 年 9 月在多利亞斯率領武裝團體，與馬里亞諾·希梅內斯會合後進軍瓜納華托。聖米格爾的武裝力量、城內兵力以及何塞·安東尼奧·托雷斯與弗朗西斯科·維拉的騎兵逐漸加入。瓜達拉哈拉方向的若瑟·瑪麗亞·加西亞·奧貝索在途中接應；希達戈負傷後由他繼續率軍，並於巴漢戰敗陣亡。莫雷洛斯原為帝國軍軍官，參加過希達戈的進軍，之後在米却肯建立較長期的戰役體系，進行多次進攻、圍城與機動戰，終於 1815 年被俘並遭處決。維森特·格雷羅長期經營南部軍區；阿古斯丁·德·伊圖維德則在 1821 年與格雷羅及埃爾內內希爾多·加萊納合作。最後階段，西班牙總督胡安·奧多尼烏抵達瓜納華托並參與談判，守軍司令安東尼奧·卡涅多則在阿爾洪迪加堡堅守。
peopleEn: Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla was a parish priest with militia experience. In September 1810 he led an armed group from Dolores, joined Mariano Jiménez, and advanced on Guanajuato. Armed forces from San Miguel, troops inside the city, and cavalry under José Antonio Torres and Francisco Villa gradually joined him. José María García Obeso joined the movement from the Guadalajara direction; after Hidalgo was wounded, he assumed command and was killed in the fighting at Baján. José María Morelos had been an imperial officer and served in Hidalgo's advance before building a more durable military system in Michoacán. He conducted campaigns, sieges, and mobile operations until his capture and execution in 1815. Vicente Guerrero maintained an organized military presence in the south for many years. In 1821 Agustín de Iturbide allied with Guerrero and Hermenegildo Galeana. In the final phase, Spanish viceroy Juan O'Donojú reached Guanajuato and joined the negotiations, while Antonio Cañedo commanded the defense of the Alhóndiga citadel.
kits: 與 1810 年時間界線相符的具名火器包括西班牙 1795 年制式燧發步槍與 1802 年制式燧發步槍，兩者均早於開戰，並配用套筒式刺刀。新西班牙各團的軍械來源與年代不同，不能把整支起義軍視為使用同一型號。起義步兵主要使用從皇家軍械庫繳獲的燧發滑膛步槍，騎兵使用直刃長矛與彎刀，炮兵則把奪得的青銅砲轉為己用。帝國軍的野戰單位配備四磅、六磅及八磅青銅野砲，省會與大型堡壘還可使用更重的守城砲。步槍彈藥以紙包火藥與分開攜帶的鉛彈供應，砲兵則攜帶炮架、炮車、炮手工具、通條、点火桿、火繩及備用楔件。遠征縱隊依靠騾匹、鞍架、硬餅乾、鹹肉、水罐、飼料與工具車維持移動；道路堵塞、牲畜缺乏及彈藥基數不足，往往迫使縱隊停隊或縮短前進距離。
kitsEn: The war in 1810 stretched across the Captaincy General of New Spain. The uprising began at Dolores and passed through San Miguel, Guanajuato, San Luis Potosí, and Valladolid before advancing toward Guadalajara and Morelia. After Hidalgo was checked at Monte de las Cruces, the remnants of his force turned toward San Blas and Baján. The imperial army relied on Mexico City, Puebla, the port of Veracruz, and provincial capitals as bases from which it controlled the principal roads and dispatched independent columns in pursuit. After 1811, military operations shifted southward into Michoacán, Oaxaca, and Zamora, while Guerrero maintained an insurgency in the south. In 1821, Iturbide and the allied army pressed toward Guanajuato from Jalisco. tactics: 起義軍在瓜納華托不是先建立完整圍城線，而是以步兵、騎兵與輕便火器迅速切斷守軍聯繫，奪取城內火藥庫、軍械與野砲，隨即把整支部隊轉向北進。這種集中兵力與快速轉向在初期有效，但長砲組、車隊和補給線也拖慢了行軍。蒙特德拉克魯塞斯一戰，帝國軍利用狹窄道路與兩側高地部署炮兵，先以火砲削弱進攻者，再以預備隊反覆衝擊；希達戈先使用騎兵與炮兵，其後投入步兵，仍未能突破封鎖。巴漢的攔截則利用追擊縱隊切斷道路、控制嚮導並形成包圍，使已經削弱的希達戈部無法展開。莫雷洛斯在米却肯採取更靈活的混合戰術，一面攻擊孤立守軍與補給縱隊，一面在有利條件下實施圍城，隨即轉移以避免長期消耗。帝國軍後來以省級堡壘和流動縱隊壓縮游擊隊活動。1821 年的瓜納華托作戰則回到正規攻城：聯軍部署野砲、控制道路，卡涅多據守厚壁堡壘；與此同時，奧多尼烏和伊圖維德進行談判，最後以投降條件而非強攻結束戰鬥。
tacticsEn: At Guanajuato, the insurgents did not first establish a formal siege line. They rapidly cut the defenders' communications with infantry, cavalry, and light firearms, seized the powder magazine, weapons, and field guns, and then turned the entire force northward. Concentrating troops and changing direction quickly were useful at first, but long artillery sections, baggage trains, and supply columns also slowed the army. At Monte de las Cruces, the imperial troops deployed artillery on a narrow road and commanding heights on both sides. Artillery weakened the attackers before fresh imperial reserves launched repeated counterattacks. Hidalgo committed cavalry and artillery first and then infantry, but he could not break through the blocking position. The interception at Baján used pursuing columns to close the roads, seize guides, and encircle the force, preventing the already depleted army under Hidalgo from deploying. Morelos adopted a more flexible combined method in Michoacán. He attacked isolated garrisons and supply columns, conducted sieges when circumstances permitted, and then moved away to avoid prolonged exhaustion. The imperial government later used provincial fortresses and mobile columns to compress insurgent operating space. The fighting at Guanajuato in 1821 returned to a conventional siege: the allied army placed field guns and covered the roads, while Cañedo held the thick-walled citadel. At the same time, O'Donojú and Iturbide negotiated, ending the battle through capitulation rather than an assault.
data: 1810 年 9 月 16 日至 1821 年 9 月 28 日相距十一年又十二天。1810 年 9 月 28 日，起義軍取得瓜納華托與阿爾洪迪加；10 月 30 日，蒙特德拉克魯塞斯戰役迫使希達戈向北撤退。1811 年 5 月 21 日，希達戈在巴漢被俘；6 月 5 日，莫雷洛斯在努馬蘭取勝；7 月 30 日，希達戈在奇瓦瓦被處決。莫雷洛斯在 1811 年下半年整建軍隊，發動多次縱深進軍，1815 年 12 月 5 日在奇亞烏特拉附近被俘，12 月 22 日在聖路易斯波托西被處決。1821 年 2 月 24 日公布伊瓜拉計畫，8 月 24 日簽訂科爾多瓦條約，9 月 27 日聯軍開始最後圍城，9 月 28 日瓜納華托守軍簽署投降書。現存命令、作戰報告與事後回憶對各次兵力及傷亡數字常有差異，因此可確定的是上述日期、路線與指揮關係，不能列出未經交叉核實的精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: From 16 September 1810 to 28 September 1821 lay eleven years and twelve days. On 28 September 1810 the insurgents took Guanajuato and the Alhóndiga. The Battle of Monte de las Cruces on 30 October forced Hidalgo to retreat north. Hidalgo was captured at Baján on 21 May 1811; Morelos won at Numarán on 5 June; and Hidalgo was executed in Chihuahua on 30 July. Morelos reorganized his army and launched deeper campaigns during the second half of 1811. He was captured near Chiautla on 5 December 1815 and executed in San Luis Potosí on 22 December. The Plan of Iguala was proclaimed on 24 February 1821, the Treaty of Córdoba was signed on 24 August, the allied army began the final siege on 27 September, and the Guanajuato garrison signed its capitulation on 28 September. Surviving orders, operational reports, and later recollections differ over strengths and losses. The dates, routes, and command relationships can therefore be stated with confidence, but precise aggregate casualty figures cannot be supplied without reliable cross-checking.
cause: 獨立戰爭的直接背景是西班牙在 1808 年發生的王位危機。費爾南多七世退位，拿破崙迫使西班牙王室退讓，約瑟夫・波拿巴取得王位；墨西哥城最高執委會及各省執委會隨即宣告自行維持權力，與塞維亞最高執委會的政治要求發生衝突。1809 年瓦利亞德利德軍官與法律人的未遂行動已顯示，中央政府的軍隊指揮、地方任命、稅務壟斷及徵調方式正在加劇不滿。1810 年，殖民當局開始取締未經批准的武裝組織，並偵查多利亞斯、瓜納華托與聖路易斯波托西之間的聯繫。希達戈在受到拘捕壓力後帶領武裝團體出發，攻入瓜納華托並奪取皇家軍械，使原本屬於執委會、主權與軍隊編制的政治衝突轉變為公開戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate background to the war was the Spanish dynastic crisis of 1808. Ferdinand VII abdicated, Napoleon compelled the Spanish royal family into exile, and Joseph Bonaparte took the throne. Mexico City's Supreme Junta and the provincial juntas then asserted their own authority, creating conflict with the Supreme Junta in Seville. The failed 1809 conspiracy in Valladolid, involving officers and a lawyer, had already exposed growing friction over military command, appointments, fiscal monopolies, and recruitment. In 1810 the colonial government began suppressing unauthorized armed organizations and investigating connections among Dolores, Guanajuato, and San Luis Potosí. Under pressure of arrest, Hidalgo led his armed group into action, entered Guanajuato, and seized royal weapons. This transformed a dispute concerning juntas, sovereignty, and military authority into open war.
impact: 希達戈在 1810 年的推進迫使總督哈維爾・韋內加斯於 12 月離開墨西哥城，並使內陸會與軍械庫短期落入起義軍控制；然而，起義軍未能把軍事突破轉成穩定政權。巴漢與蒙特德拉克魯塞斯的失敗使帝國軍得以恢復縱隊體系，起義重心因此南移。莫雷洛斯在占領區建立軍政機構、任命軍官、維持補給並派員接觸外國政府，使零散武裝逐漸接近區域性軍隊。格雷羅在南部保留組織與戰鬥能力，沒有隨希達戈和莫雷洛斯先後覆滅而消失。1814 年費爾南多七世復位後，帝國當局加強軍事追剿；1820 年要求恢復 1812 年憲法的政治運動又使皇家阵营分裂，促使部分帝國軍官接受伊瓜拉計畫並與起義軍合作。獨立達成後，原殖民軍隊與起義軍的指揮網路成為新政權核心，但西班牙本土政府未立即批准科爾多瓦條約，正式外交承認直到 1836 年才完成。
impactEn: Hidalgo's 1810 advance forced Viceroy Javier Venegas to leave Mexico City in December and temporarily placed inland councils and arsenals under insurgent control, but the insurgents did not convert that military breakthrough into a stable government. The defeats at Baján and Monte de las Cruces allowed the imperial government to restore its column system, causing the insurgency to shift south. Morelos established military-administrative bodies in occupied areas, appointed officers, maintained supply lines, and sent agents to foreign governments, turning scattered armed bands into a more durable regional force. Guerrero retained an organized military presence in the south rather than disappearing with the successive defeats of Hidalgo and Morelos. After Ferdinand VII returned to the throne in 1814, the colonial government intensified military repression. The movement demanding restoration of the 1812 Constitution in 1820 divided the imperial camp and led some imperial officers to accept the Plan of Iguala and cooperate with the insurgents. After independence, the command networks of both the colonial and insurgent armies became central to the new state. The metropolitan Spanish government did not approve the Treaty of Córdoba immediately, and formal diplomatic recognition was not completed until 1836.
result: 1821 年 9 月 27 日，伊圖維德率領的聯軍抵達瓜納華托，設置野砲並封鎖通往阿爾洪迪加的道路。卡涅多仍控制堡壘，外部援軍也正接近，因此守方無法單靠拖延脫離。奧多尼烏抵達後與伊圖維德談判，9 月 28 日簽訂投降書；帝國軍依條款帶著武器與軍事榮譽撤離，堡壘、剩餘火炮及軍械移交聯軍。伊圖維德隨後進入瓜納華托，聯軍控制新西班牙的主要政治中心，戰爭至此在作戰層面結束。科爾多瓦條約確認西班牙殖民當局承認新的獨立國家，但費爾南多七世沒有批准條約，因而軍事勝利與西班牙本土的外交承認並未同時完成。政治後續仍不穩定：伊圖維德於 1822 年加冕為皇帝，1823 年退位，1824 年邦聯憲法建立新的共和秩序。瓜納華托投降解決的是殖民軍退出與獨立軍占據首都的問題，並沒有立即決定墨西哥長期的國家形式。
resultEn: On 27 September 1821, Iturbide's allied army reached Guanajuato, established field guns, and blocked the roads leading to the Alhóndiga. Cañedo still controlled the citadel and imperial reinforcements were approaching, so delay alone could not break the situation. After O'Donojú arrived, he negotiated with Iturbide, and the capitulation was signed on 28 September. Under its terms, the imperial troops departed with their weapons and military honors, while the citadel, remaining artillery, and military stores passed to the allied army. Iturbide then entered Guanajuato, placing the principal political center of New Spain under insurgent control and bringing the war to an operational end. The Treaty of Córdoba confirmed the Spanish colonial authorities' recognition of the new independent state, but Ferdinand VII did not ratify the treaty, so military victory and metropolitan diplomatic recognition did not occur at the same time. The political aftermath remained unstable. Iturbide was crowned emperor in 1822, abdicated in 1823, and the federal constitution of 1824 established a new republican order. The capitulation at Guanajuato resolved the withdrawal of the colonial army and the insurgent occupation of the capital, but it did not immediately settle Mexico's permanent form of government.
